technology_name: GSK-2126458 AND ROTTLERIN BASED COMPOSITION TO MIMIC THE EFFECTS OF CALORIE RESTRICTION FOR NEUROLOGICAL DISORDERS
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Managing neurodegenerative conditions, brain cancer, and age-regulated central nervous system (CNS) disorders effectively without causing steep systemic side effects remains an open bottleneck.
description: A synergistic pharmaceutical small-molecule composition combining the PI3K/mTOR inhibitor GSK-2126458 with rottlerin compounds, formulated to mimic calorie restriction path mechanisms and upregulate neuroprotective brain genes.
applications: Neurodegenerative disease therapeutics (Alzheimer's/Parkinson's), neuro-oncology treatment plans, age-related dementia management, and clinical neuroprotective supplements.
